Class Noul

java.lang.Object
com.galitianu.jev4j.Noul
All Implemented Interfaces:
Question<NoulAnswer>
public final class Noul extends Object implements Question<NoulAnswer>
A yes/no question. The answer is the probability of "yes", from 0 to 1.
